prompt: Research one critical-minerals lithium-cycle investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: The 2026 lithium rebound may be cyclical near term, while a durable late-decade shortage remains plausible as stationary storage diversifies demand and prior underinvestment slows supply.
inputs.drivers: EV and storage demand; LFP and carbonate mix; Chinese lepidolite and project restarts; inventories; contract versus spot pricing; capex and financing; sodium-ion; recycling; chemistry efficiency; permitting and industrial policy.
inputs.value_chain: Hard-rock and brine miners; lithium converters; development projects; diversified miners; battery and storage manufacturers; sodium-ion and recycling substitutes.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed cites IEA supply-gap risk, storage growth, and delayed investment, with ALB, SQM, LAC, RIO, and SGML as operating or optionality hypotheses.
inputs.invalidation: Chinese supply restarts, lepidolite expansion, sodium-ion, recycling, or rapid project financing can restore surplus; contract lags, leverage, policy, and commissioning risk can overwhelm spot upside.
